dataset.name: NYU stage I lung adenocarcinoma cohort (GSE229705)
dataset.description: Independent stage I lung adenocarcinoma cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual source-defined progression-free follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study prospectively collected matched primary lung adenocarcinoma and tumor-adjacent lung specimens from 143 treatment-naive patients undergoing R0 resection at NYU Langone Health. RNA quality control retained 123 matched pairs. TRACE Explorer uses only the 123 primary-tumor profiles and never combines them with the adjacent-normal profiles.

metadata.source_program: NYU Langone stage I lung adenocarcinoma matched tumor-normal study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Nature Communications Source Data
metadata.library_method: Mammalian rRNA-depleted Trio total-RNA libraries sequenced as paired-end 100-nucleotide reads, aligned to GRCh38 with STAR and quantified at gene level with featureCounts
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined postoperative progression-free survival after R0 resection
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source progression event includes second primary lung tumors, locoregional recurrence and systemic metastasis. TRACE Explorer preserves the publication's PFS label and event coding; this endpoint is not reinterpreted as TCGA PFI, DFI, RFS, DSS or OS.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The frozen GEO series contains 123 tumor-normal pairs. Only titles ending in -T are eligible, yielding one primary-tumor profile for each of 123 unique patients.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Nature Communications Source Data sheet Figure 5b contains exactly the 123 expression-linked Study_ID records used in the publication's PFS curve, with individual TTP days and progression status. The linkage to the GEO patient characteristic is one-to-one and complete.
metadata.source_tissue_note: The source article developed its main inflammatory module in tumor-adjacent normal lung. This repository release instead exposes the matched primary-tumor transcriptomes to satisfy the direct tumor-expression eligibility policy and does not claim to reproduce the adjacent-normal signature result.
metadata.overlap_note: The NYU stage I cohort is institutionally independent of TCGA-LUAD and of the BMC/LHMC, Uppsala and TCIA LUAD cohorts already registered in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO matrix and CC BY 4.0 Source Data in place. Source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Treatment-naive stage I lung adenocarcinoma primary tumor collected at R0 resection

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided GRCh38 gene symbols in the pinned GEO count matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The frozen matrix contains 60,591 non-empty unique gene symbols; no implicit aggregation is applied.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 60,591 source gene rows for each selected tumor and applies log2(CPM + 1). The adjacent-normal columns are excluded before normalization, and values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-defined progression-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: First source-coded progression: second primary lung tumor, locoregional recurrence or systemic metastasis
